# ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists the zones every cluster in the organisation serves with the organisation's own credential. The counterpart of `ankra org custom-dns-zones list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zones" "all" {}

output "zones" {
  value = data.ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zones.all.zones[*].zone
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Declared zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `credential_name` (String) Credential that publishes into the zone.
- `id` (String) The zone name.
- `policy` (String) external-dns policy the clusters run for the zone.
- `provider_kind` (String) Credential family: `webhook`, `cloudflare` or `avura`.
- `zone` (String) Zone name.
